description: Python script for preparing gesture sensor data, reading raw data files, generating negative samples, and saving combined data in JSON format.

methods.name: prepare_original_data
methods.description: Reads collected gesture data from CSV files, processes and appends to data list.

methods.name: generate_negative_data
methods.description: Generates synthetic negative gesture data with different movement patterns and appends to data list.

methods.name: write_data
methods.description: Writes the processed data list to a JSON file.
